sources.literature: cycle2_20261113/literature; new MLMC/MFMC ancestors in SOURCES.json

scope.mechanism: Independent old bank plus paired current-minus-old credit drift; six-edge complete maintenance isolates estimator from acquisition ranking.

estimand.action_gain: Y_A,e=Q(A xor e)-Q(A); Y_B,e=Q(B xor e)-Q(B)

primary_warm_design.bank: Shared identical newly generated I12 bank; all methods charged its construction; independent of new C
primary_warm_design.baseline_coefficients: beta_R1 estimated only from authorized R1 I/C development, frozen before fresh R2; not from R2 S or R1 S
primary_warm_design.formal_new_source: Official-train source, exclude all previous development/qualification/exposure IDs; source/model/config unchanged unless separately amended

counterfactual_costs.four_world_joint_calls_per_question: 13+4k for this specific three-receiver A->B shift
counterfactual_costs.primary_claim: Common complete upper caps; actual expenditure separately measured; not equality of actual spend
cost_measurement_levels: Exact observed token counts reconstructed from pinned node outputs
Observed joint four-world physical calls and resident time
Cold-B time reconstructed from cached nodes is PROFILED, not measured standalone execution
Bounded fresh qualification if standalone latency is needed
counterfactual_costs.random_cost_stopping: Freeze sample counts before outcomes; do not stop at outcome-correlated realised cost and assume fixed-n unbiasedness

exploratory_R1_diagnostic.source_arrays: Sanitized scores/costs only; no raw questions, gold, S outputs, S costs or S summary
exploratory_R1_diagnostic.release_condition: R1 purchase/service-action receipts already immutable, or isolated evaluator attests diagnostic cannot alter R1 execution
exploratory_R1_diagnostic.transport_training: First 3 frozen-order rows of training fold
exploratory_R1_diagnostic.direct_training: First 5 frozen-order rows of training fold
exploratory_R1_diagnostic.validation: Both estimators use all 6 current-B rows in the heldout fold for chosen-action quality; same editor and tie rule as R1
exploratory_R1_diagnostic.generic_cv_diagnostic: Leave-one-episode-out beta estimated from remaining seven episodes, no heldout-episode fitting
exploratory_R1_diagnostic.r1_no_change_A: Y_A^C reused as both graph worlds only to check exact identity; no artificial fresh evidence or empirical drift claim

G0.name: INTEGRITY
G0.pass: All 8 episodes complete; expected I/C counts; hashes, question disjointness, paired seeds and full cost provenance valid; S_access=false

G1.name: SUPPORT
G1.pass: At least 12 distinct C questions with any nonzero current action gain; at least 4 episodes with nonzero within-question target action-gain variance; aggregate direct risk > 1e-4
G1.rationale: Prospective investment guard, not a mathematical power guarantee

G2.name: COST_AND_BANK_RISK
G2.pass: point ratio<=0.80 and exploratory 90% bootstrap upper<1.00; bootstrap denominator never nonpositive; report all cells including zeros; full observed-token cost-weighted risk ratio point<=1
G2.resampling: 10000 paired episode-and-question bootstrap draws, seed 72031; I and C sampled independently, C A/B kept paired; 8 clusters only, not calibrated confirmation
G2.supporting_cost_test: Report actual incremental-token variance products and full construction coefficient; no cold-B cached-time substitution
G2.failure: NO_GO_CURRENT_BANK_AND_QUOTA if clear ratio>=1; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_CURRENT_BANK_AND_QUOTA

G3.name: DECISION_RELEVANCE
G3.pass: Predefined R1-C two-fold episode-mean quality difference transport-direct>=0.01 and transport-old>=0; at least 6/8 episode transport-direct contrasts nonnegative
G3.failure: NO_GO_DECISION_VALUE or INCONCLUSIVE; do not switch primary to favorable cell/role/budget
G3.interval_status: All intervals exploratory; no confirmation from 6-row folds

G4.name: NEW_PILOT_FEASIBILITY
G4.pass: Both R2 new qualification and complete frozen coverage fit pre-reserved <=16 GPUh, or separately frozen <=32 GPUh from unchanged global remaining budget before starting; no S-based extension

gates.result: GO_NEW_INDEPENDENT_DEVELOPMENT_PILOT only if G0-G4 pass; otherwise retain evidence and continue another authorized distinct candidate, not project stop
secondary_fixed_nonselective: m24,m48 algebraic projections labelled extrapolation, not observed banks and not substitute primary gate
beta*=population diagnostic envelope not deployable oracle
dirty vs non-dirty slices not validity certificates

no_change.exact_graph_identity: If model/prompts/source distribution/graph and RNG protocol identical, skip drift acquisition for every method; known D=0 does not mean mu_A known.
no_change.pooled_control: If new same-graph samples are deliberately purchased, strong control pools independent old+new samples; fixed beta1 returns old bank and can be strictly worse.
no_change.weak_locality: Different receivers/unchanged edge neighborhood do not certify unchanged final credit because aggregator interactions remain.

formal_pilot_outline.new_pilot_primary: A->B future accuracy: beta1 transport minus direct under complete shared caps; source/CV controls retained.
formal_pilot_outline.progress: Freeze a new independently powered confirmation only after valid prospective development evidence; neither R1 nor R2 final/sealed test is used for tuning.

execution_state.reason: Draft and synthetic mathematical checks only
